items.name: Source
items.tip: What the plugin hears from your DAW. In a DAW this is the track you put Scratch Cat FX on.

items.name: DAW play
items.tip: Start or stop the track as if your DAW were playing it. Shortcut: P.

items.name: Load file
items.tip: Load your own audio file (wav, mp3, flac, ogg). It stays in this browser tab and is never uploaded.

items.name: Capture
items.tip: Grab the last bars of the DAW input into the scratch deck. Here it grabs the whole test loop.

items.name: Host BPM
items.tip: The tempo your DAW runs at. Sync matches the deck to it. Double-click resets.

items.name: Waveform
items.tip: Grab the waveform and drag it like a record to scratch. Beat lines are every beat; taller lines are bars. Mouse wheel nudges.

items.name: 2 BARS
items.tip: Show 2 bars across the waveform.

items.name: 4 BARS
items.tip: Show 4 bars across the waveform.

items.name: 8 BARS
items.tip: Show 8 bars across the waveform.

items.name: 16 BARS
items.tip: Show 16 bars across the waveform.

items.name: Delete
items.tip: Delete switch: while on, clicking a set hot cue removes it. Holding Shift while clicking does the same.

items.name: Hot cue 1
items.tip: Hot cue 1. Empty: click to set a marker here. Set: click to jump to it. Shift-click, or the Delete switch, removes it. Right-click edits name, colour, position and on/off.

items.name: Hot cue 2
items.tip: Hot cue 2. Empty: click to set a marker here. Set: click to jump to it. Shift-click, or the Delete switch, removes it. Right-click edits name, colour, position and on/off.

items.name: Vinyl
items.tip: On: pausing slows the record down like a turntable. Off: it stops at once.

items.name: Trans.
items.tip: Transform gate: chops the sound on and off in time with the beat.

items.name: Stutter
items.tip: Hold: retriggers the cue point every 1/16 beat.

items.name: Brake
items.tip: Slows the record to a stop.

items.name: Backspin
items.tip: The record spins back fast, then stops.

items.name: Roll
items.tip: Hold: rolls a tiny loop of 1/8 beat; letting go lands where the song would have been.

items.name: Censor
items.tip: Hold: plays backwards; letting go jumps to where the song would have been.

items.name: Loop of 1/4 beat from here
items.tip: Loop of 1/4 beat from here. Press again to leave the loop.

items.name: Loop of 1/2 beat from here
items.tip: Loop of 1/2 beat from here. Press again to leave the loop.

items.name: Loop of 1 beat from here
items.tip: Loop of 1 beat from here. Press again to leave the loop.

items.name: Loop of 2 beats from here
items.tip: Loop of 2 beats from here. Press again to leave the loop.

items.name: Loop of 4 beats from here
items.tip: Loop of 4 beats from here. Press again to leave the loop.

items.name: Loop of 8 beats from here
items.tip: Loop of 8 beats from here. Press again to leave the loop.

items.name: Loop in
items.tip: Set the loop start here.

items.name: Loop out
items.tip: Set the loop end here and start looping.

items.name: Exit
items.tip: Leave the loop.

items.name: CUE
items.tip: CUE. While playing: jumps back to the cue point and pauses. While paused: sets the cue point here; hold to preview from it.

items.name: Play or pause the deck
items.tip: Play or pause the deck.

items.name: Sync
items.tip: Match this deck's tempo to the host BPM (or to the master deck) and keep it matched.

items.name: Key lock
items.tip: Key lock: change the tempo without changing the pitch.

items.name: Quant
items.tip: Quantize: cue points, hot cues and loops snap to the nearest beat.

items.name: Tempo
items.tip: Speed of this deck. Up is faster. The range buttons set how far it goes. Double-click resets.

items.name: How far the tempo fader goes (percent)
items.tip: How far the tempo fader goes (percent).
How far the tempo fader goes (percent).
How far the tempo fader goes (percent).

items.name: Reset
items.tip: Put the tempo fader back to zero.

items.name: Trim
items.tip: Input gain of the deck. Double-click resets.

items.name: High
items.tip: High shelf (4 kHz). Double-click resets.

items.name: Mid
items.tip: Mid band (1 kHz). Double-click resets.

items.name: Low
items.tip: Low shelf (250 Hz). Double-click resets.

items.name: Color
items.tip: One-knob filter: left is low-pass, right is high-pass. Double-click resets.

items.name: High
items.tip: Silences the highs. Keep it pressed during a drop swap.

items.name: Mid
items.tip: Silences the mids.

items.name: Low
items.tip: Silences the lows.

items.name: Deck
items.tip: Channel fader of the scratch deck. Double-click resets.

items.name: Master
items.tip: Output level. Double-click resets.

items.name: Cross
items.tip: Crossfader: left is the scratch deck, right is the DAW input playing straight. Double-click resets.

items.name: Curve
items.tip: Smooth: both full in the middle. Sharp: cuts like a battle mixer. Constant: equal power.

items.name: FX on
items.tip: Send the effects to the scratch deck only, or to everything.

items.name: FX 1
items.tip: Turn this effect slot on or off.

items.name: Type
items.tip: What this slot does.

items.name: Amount
items.tip: Filter: sweep from low-pass to high-pass. Echo: delay time in beats. Reverb: size. Flanger: rate. Crush: amount. Double-click resets.

items.name: Dry/Wet
items.tip: How much of the effect is mixed in. Double-click resets.

items.name: FX 2
items.tip: Turn this effect slot on or off.

items.name: Type
items.tip: What this slot does.

items.name: Amount
items.tip: Filter: sweep from low-pass to high-pass. Echo: delay time in beats. Reverb: size. Flanger: rate. Crush: amount. Double-click resets.

items.name: Dry/Wet
items.tip: How much of the effect is mixed in. Double-click resets.

items.name: FX 3
items.tip: Turn this effect slot on or off.

items.name: Type
items.tip: What this slot does.

items.name: Amount
items.tip: Filter: sweep from low-pass to high-pass. Echo: delay time in beats. Reverb: size. Flanger: rate. Crush: amount. Double-click resets.

items.name: Dry/Wet
items.tip: How much of the effect is mixed in. Double-click resets.

items.name: On
items.tip: Turns the PurrOne colour stage on or off. It sits after the three effects and before the master.

items.name: Drive
items.tip: Smooth tanh saturation. Keep it under 80 % for warm, over 80 % for hard. Double-click resets.

items.name: Transistor
items.tip: Lopsided transistor curve: adds even harmonics, a thicker, warmer edge. Double-click resets.

items.name: Fuzz
items.tip: Fuzz: biased clipping with an octave-up growl. Nasty above 80 %. Double-click resets.

items.name: Mix
items.tip: Dry/wet of the colour stage. Double-click resets.

items.name: Window 100 %
items.tip: Window size. Drag any edge or corner of the plugin to resize it; the shape stays the same. Double-click here for 100 %.
